title: Project Manager (KUP)
description:
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and execution plans.
* Monitor project progress and identify schedule risks, delays, and mitigation measures.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, QA/QC, and Construction teams for timely project execution.
* Track project costs, budgets, commitments, and forecast expenditures.
* Prepare project progress reports, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Conduct project review meetings with internal stakeholders and clients.
* Ensure compliance with contract requirements, project specifications, and company procedures.
* Manage change orders, variation requests, and project documentation.
* Monitor resource allocation and productivity across project activities.
* Coordinate fabrication, load\-out, transportation, and offshore installation readiness activities.
* Support risk management by identifying, evaluating, and mitigating project risks.
* Liaise with customers, classification societies, consultants, and subcontractors.
* Ensure adherence to HSE, quality, and operational excellence standards.
* Facilitate lessons learned and project close\-out activities
